results.reason: all facts present; expected source cited
results.answer: G7 (ATC ground restrictions) is PARTIAL: lagged NAS-delay proxies have been built, but historical ground-stop/GDP event data is unavailable.[1] The proxy is T-[number removed] feasible using BTS_M3, but NAS-delay shares are not ground-stop/GDP events, and the historical event archive has still not been found.[3] (unverified)

results.question: What does the G2 ground handling proxy actually measure?
results.reason: all facts present; expected source cited
results.answer: The G2 ground handling proxy measures mishandled bags per 1,000 at the operating-carrier-month level, using Form-1 data from 3 months back. [2] It measures baggage handling only, not fueling, cleaning or turn readiness. [2]
